extracted.intended_audience: historians, students, and general readers of Spanish colonial Philippine primary sources
extracted.subtask_description: An edition/translation of 16th-century Spanish letters and voyage relations (Legazpi, Goiti, Fray Diego de Herrera) reporting on voyages, colonization, encounters with indigenous peoples, and military actions in the Philippines. The page presents primary-source narrative material rather than evaluative criteria or production guidelines.
